localFacts.fact: Gemeente Amsterdam: for film recordings in the city you file a free filmmelding at least 4 weeks ahead; the rules are in the Filmprotocol, and for moving shots (rijdende filmopnames) you upload a map of the situation. The municipality replies within max. 6 weeks. General information, not legal advice.

KLM: hand baggage, including handles and wheels, max. 55 x 35 x 25 cm; the folding clamp dollies (K&F 38,5 cm, SmallRig 43 cm, NEEWER 45 cm folded) fit that length, the Manfrotto 114 (64,7 cm closed) does not.
Local terms: statiefdolly / statief op wielen, wielen met rem, rubberen voeten vs. spikes, rijdende shot, dollyrails.

localPainPoints.pain: Not every tripod can be set at its narrowest spread, because the dolly's shortest leg setting is a bit too big.
localPainPoints.fix: Measure from the tripod's center to one foot at your shooting spread and compare it with the dolly's leg range (NEEWER 27,4 to 40 cm, SmallRig 298 to 435 mm) before you buy (English post's fit steps).

quotes.text: Minpuntje is echter dat niet alle statieven op het laagste niveau kunnen ingesteld worden omdat de kleinste stand net iets te groot is.

localPainPoints.pain: Back pain from carrying heavy gear around a set.
localPainPoints.fix: A folding clamp dolly lets you roll the tripod instead of lifting it; but heavy bases add weight themselves (Manfrotto 6,48 kg, Lineo 10,7 kg), so pick the light SmallRig (1,8 kg) for sets that move a lot (English post).
